subject: Startups
title: Why Most VC Funds Lose Money
description: A short lesson to help you apply Why Most VC Funds Lose Money.

hook.text: Here's a secret: most VC funds don't beat a simple stock index fund. The industry's average returns are mediocre.

buildup.text: Studies show only the top quartile of VC funds consistently outperform public markets. The rest underperform.

discovery.text: Returns are concentrated in a handful of elite firms. Access to the best deals creates a self-reinforcing cycle.

twist.text: LPs keep investing in VC because the top funds return 3–5x. The hope of finding the next Sequoia keeps capital flowing.

climax.text: VC is not a good investment on average. It's an incredible investment if you pick the right fund manager.

punchline.text: VC looks amazing at the top. The average is ordinary.

quiz.question: How do most VC funds perform compared to stock index funds?
